name: What is the process for installing new recessed lighting in an existing kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing new recessed lighting in an existing kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing new recessed lighting in an existing kitchen typically involves planning the layout, cutting holes in the ceiling, running new electrical wiring, installing the recessed housings, and finally, installing the trim and bulbs. Hometelligent Inc. begins with a thorough site assessment to determine structural feasibility and electrical capacity. We then protect your kitchen surfaces, expertly install the new fixtures, and meticulously repair any disturbed drywall, ensuring minimal disruption and a clean finish. Inspection and testing are performed to confirm proper function and safety before project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves planning, cutting ceiling holes, running wiring, installing housings and trims, followed by electrical testing and drywall repair.
